title: Chapter 429
text:
"Iron Fire Castle, Arcane Academy, Crystal Mountain, Purple Sea Islands, Card Peak …"

Five teams from different forces surrounded the airdrop pod in the center, facing each other. When the smugglers at the side saw this, they immediately cowered and did not dare to approach. They hurriedly retreated into the forest and observed secretly while trembling in fear.

Every time space trash fell, it was a treasure that all the organizations were determined to get. This one landed near the City of Runes. All the teams present knew that time was tight and immediately attacked.

Tut tut tut!

The warriors of Iron Fire Castle were the first to open fire. Their rifles spat out tongues of flame, and bullets rained down in all directions.

Gunpowder and firearms were the special technology of Iron Fire Castle. Most of the people present dodged to avoid the bullets.

Except for the warriors of Card Peak.

These people were wearing strange instruments on their arms, similar to brass-colored armors. They were shaped like small discs, and there were many card slots on the sides of the discs. This was the core technology of the Card Peak's battle card. These people took out a bright and colorful card from the center of the discs and inserted it into the card slots. The next second, there was a sudden change.

Buzz!

A light blue energy shield formed in front of the round plates. The bullets created ripples when they hit the shield, blocking all the attacks.

Obviously, this was a product of another system. The extraterrestrial item of Card Peak contained the technology of using cards as carriers to store, convert, and use energy.

Bang bang bang!

At the same time, the warriors of the other organizations began to attack. They were engaged in a chaotic battle. All kinds of energy radiances flickered in the forest as they roared incessantly.

Grenades pierced through Arcane Shields, sharp claws cut through metal gun barrels, and sparks flew.

The spears created by the cards pierced through the expanded and strengthened bodies. The boiling blood in the bodies spurted out, giving off white smoke and sizzling sounds.

The radiation released by the crystal shattered the battle cards, and the torn cards exploded into light fragments that filled the sky. The energy dissipated, turning into a shockwave that blew up the humus on the ground nearby, and black soil splashed everywhere.

These were all the elite warriors of their organizations. The arcane attacks of Arcane Academy, the crystal energy of Crystal Mountain, the battle transformation potion of Purple Sea Islands … Different battle techniques collided with each other.

No matter who got close to the 'space trash' in the center, they would be attacked together. The five parties were in a stalemate.

Woo!

All of a sudden, the sound of a horn came from the forest in the distance. Everyone's expression changed.

"That's the City of Runes' soldier number. Their search team is almost here."

The sniper of Steel Fire Castle adjusted his scope and saw a large group of creatures approaching quickly, so he said in a serious tone.

"It's too late. We can't let the City of Runes take what we can't get. Prepare the explosives and blow up this falling object!"

The captain of the Iron Fire Fortress shouted. His subordinates took out all kinds of detonators and grenades and threw them at the airdrop cabin.

The other forces did not want to be left behind. They all took out destructive weapons and attacked the airdrop pod. These people had the same idea of not wanting to support the enemy.

Rumble!!

The sound of the explosion shook the night. The expanding flames mixed with black smoke rose and covered the airdrop cabin.

"Continue!"

Space junk that could fall to a planet was usually very hard, but even so, they had to do their best to cause damage so that it would be difficult for hostile forces to study it.

Just as these people were preparing for the second round of fire, there was a clear sound of an air pump reducing pressure coming from the "space junk" in the middle, and the hatch slid open. Everyone saw a figure moving in the smoke, followed by a strange voice, but it was in their language."… Have you guys had enough?"Pushing aside the smoke, Han Xiao walked out in large strides. He had landed with his physical body and did not activate the Void Dragon mechanical suit. This broken airdrop cabin gave him a headache, and the internal system crashed during the collision. He could not even open the door. It was a disgrace to the airdrop world.It took him a while to restart the system. He could hear all the sounds of battle outside.Although the various forces on Planet Secret Blue had so-called 'supernatural' weapons, in his opinion, the level of technology was very low, and the power was mediocre. Even if he did not wear a mechanical suit, the enemy would have a hard time breaking through his defense.Han Xiao did not care about the battle outside at all, but these people wanted to blow up the airdrop cabin. This was intolerable. If the rental broke, they had to pay for it!As soon as Han Xiao appeared, the scene froze.Dead silence spread.These soldiers stared at Han Xiao blankly. Their expressions seemed to have frozen, and the shock was frozen on their faces. Even the smugglers who were secretly observing from the side opened their mouths wide, dumbfounded."Alien … Alien!"The space trash in the past was all inanimate objects.This was the first living creature!An alien from the endless universe!Fear, shock, greed … Countless emotions flashed across the faces of these soldiers.Everyone's breathing became heavy, and they had the same thought at the same time."We have to get the alien!He's too valuable! "At this time, footsteps sounded in the forest, and a large group of City of Runes guards finally arrived at the scene. Two hundred people, wearing standard guard armor, a hundred melee guards with shields and swords, and a hundred archers with short crossbows. Runes were carved on the surface of their weapons and armor to increase attack and defense, as well as strengthen the body.The expressions of the soldiers from Steel Fire Castle and the other organizations changed. "It's the elite guerilla team of City of Runes. We've wasted too much time!""Put down your weapons!"The commander of the Rune Force yelled. He looked at the airdrop cabin at the crash site and then looked at Han Xiao beside it. After some analysis, he came to the same conclusion as the others. His eyes were wide open, and his face was filled with shock. He decisively ordered, "Surround them and chase the enemy away. This is the territory of the City of Runes. No one can take what's ours!"The faces of the soldiers from the other organizations were solemn, and they quickly backed off. They had too few people, so they did not dare get surrounded.According to the usual practice, they would try their best to destroy what they could not get. However, the alien was too precious. Many people could not make up their minds. Should they really kill the alien? This was unprecedented. Perhaps they should not do this …The eyes of the Steel Fire Castle's captain were fierce, and his murderous intent rose. He clenched his teeth and ordered, "Don't worry so much. Our duty is to follow orders. Since we can't get that alien, we can't let the City of Runes get him. An alien from the endless universe!

Bang!

The gunshot was deafening.

Everyone hurriedly looked at the alien in the middle.

Han Xiao tilted his head and slowly turned back. There was a white mark on his forehead with smoke coming out of it. However, his skin was not even scratched.

In the Blue Star, even a Grade C could take on gunpowder guns head-on. A Grade B would not be afraid at all. Although he was a Mechanic, his health and resistance were even higher than Pugilists who trained their bodies. Crude gunpowder weapons would not be able to break through his defense.

Shock and astonishment appeared on everyone's faces, as if their expressions had changed.

Only then did they realize that the guy in front of them was not an inanimate object that they could fight over but a mysterious guest from space.

Danger Level: Unknown!

Be it the soldiers from the other organizations at the beginning or the City of Runes guards that arrived later, they were all his targets.

The mechanical beasts brazenly pounced forward, and everyone hurriedly met them head-on, losing their heads out of fear. However, when all sorts of weapons landed on the mechanical beasts' bodies, they could only create sparks on the armor. It was a completely one-sided battle, and the mechanical beasts easily defeated everyone.

A few razor-sharp tails pierced into the sniper's chest, and blood flowed out from his mouth. Before he could cry out in pain, the few mechanical beasts around him pulled their tails, and the sniper's body was torn into pieces like a broken sack.

The stench quickly spread.

The battle lasted less than ten minutes, and everyone was lying on the ground. Blood flowed everywhere, and screams could be heard. Other than the soldiers of the Iron Fire Castle, Han Xiao did not kill anyone else. After all, he needed someone to pass the message.

The smugglers in the forest had escaped death, and their legs were trembling with fear. Many people were so scared that they sat on the ground.

In the blink of an eye, he defeated two to three hundred elite soldiers. This alien is terrifying!

The chaotic situation was suppressed, and the local soldiers all calmed down.

Han Xiao glanced at them and calmly said, "Let me introduce myself. I'm a mercenary from space. I came to your planet specifically to find a strange wooden statue. According to my senses, the statue is in that city not far away. If you're willing to hand it over, I can exchange some information about the universe's environment with you. If you refuse, this place is not far away from that city, so I'll go and get it myself. Time is limited. I hope to get your reply before tomorrow morning. "

Through the translation device, his words became the language of Planet Secret Blue. Everyone was shocked. Seeing that Han Xiao did not plan to kill, they could only suppress their chaotic thoughts and stand up carefully. They supported each other and retreated in panic.

The soldiers of different organizations left without any more conflicts. They were rushing back to report to Han Xiao. This was the most important thing.

The ground was a mess, and the smugglers had run away. Han Xiao did not care about them.

"The political structure of this planet is very low-level. A technology can create a city, and a city is equivalent to a political system. My arrival is big news to them. Because there is no connection to the galaxy, there is no systematic Super knowledge here. There is only their personal strength system or some incomplete Super information. Their individual strength level is very weak. The highest is Grade C, and their numbers are even lower than Blue Star's. "

With his Grade B strength, he could wipe out this planet. Even though Grade B's were common in the galaxy and were not difficult to kill, they were almost invincible on a lower-level planet. The organizations on Planet Secret Blue only had the advantage of numbers against him.

Han Xiao smiled. Mechanics were the least afraid of being ganged up on.

However, the organizations on Planet Secret Blue might have some powerful weapons as their trump cards. Han Xiao did not ignore this possibility.

"After receiving my news, the best result is naturally for the City of Runes to hand over the statue, but the possibility is not high." Han Xiao shook his head. He knew how arrogant these people were. They would most likely not compromise.

If he waited here for a day, what he would face the next morning would not be a smiling face but an army.

However, this was Han Xiao's plan. He would leave one night for the City of Runes to gather the army, so he could destroy the enemy's mentality and save time. He loved to see the enemy's confident look the most.

Herlous and the others were still on the spaceship. It would be easier to shock the enemy if he came alone.

Although he had three statues and could locate the last one, which made it easier to steal, Han Xiao did not want to go through so much trouble.

Steal? That's still unparalleled!

This time, he finally did not need to use his brain and could solve the problem with his fists. He was overjoyed and could not wait to use his sword to kill pigs and sheep.

"Facing the encirclement of thousands of people alone, if I win, I can trigger an achievement talent. I think it's called One Against a Thousand Men." Han Xiao suddenly remembered.

Looking at the mess on the ground, Han Xiao climbed to the top of the airdrop cabin, closed his eyes, and started to wait.

…

This was the first alien to arrive!

Alive!

The City of Runes was shocked!

The entire Planet Secret Blue was shocked!
